sections.title: AWS Study Tools (Gen 1)
sections.summary: First-generation AWS certification study tools: an MCQ practice engine over ~5,300 questions in 11 datasets and a services glossary with type-in quiz mode. Also holds raw PDF-extraction artifacts (1,292 images, 1,725 tables) not wired into the UI.

sections.title: AWS Study Kit
sections.summary: Second-generation AWS Study Kit covering CLF-C02, AIF-C01 and SAA-C03: 82 comparison tables, a 979-entry glossary and 122 annotated figures in a combined browser, plus a visual SAA study guide and a 745-question practice engine. Inter font, light/dark themes, localStorage bookmarks.

sections.title: BCF Whitepapers

entries.title: BCF: A Specification-Driven Methodology for Autonomous Software Engineering Agents

sections.summary: Two drafts of the BCF competition whitepaper for the DeepMind/Kaggle Gemma 4 Agent Competition: specification-driven graph reasoning for autonomous SWE agents on gemma-4-31b, plus the BCF-SWE-Python taxonomy of 129 human-verified repair tasks. Draft 02 reframes draft 01's measured claims as expected results.

sections.title: ChronoSync Timelines
sections.summary: ChronoSync zoomable timeline apps: a PixiJS/WebGL pan-and-zoom career timeline of Beyoncé with eight tracks and guided-tour wings, plus older multi-subject comparisons (Jobs, Zuckerberg, Musk, Gates). Dark cinematic slate palette with gold and pink accents.

sections.title: BSH Game & Docs

entries.title: BSH Game - Physics Puzzle Game v20 (Canvas2D)

sections.summary: An Art-of-Balance-style Canvas2D physics stacking game (12.5k lines, level editor, themed materials) plus its research corpus: 27 markdown implementation plans for the same Unity clone written by different AI models, and a 65-category FOSS self-hosting shortlist.

sections.title: CVX Research Hub

entries.title: Comprehensive Resource Guide — Intelligent Discussion & Debate

sections.summary: Research-document hub for the site owner's projects: DUKR advertising/audience research, industry competitive analyses, a 36-item Gemma-4/Kaggle competition corpus with BCF whitepaper drafts and roadmaps, and the Cooly platform master plan. Browsed through the shared Markdown Viewer.

sections.title: DeepAgent Winners Showcase
sections.summary: Single-page showcase of the 19 winners of the DeepAgent AI-powered-app competition, each with a screenshot carousel and description. Purple-gradient background with white rounded cards.

sections.title: CVX Splash Demos
sections.summary: CVX Splash — the visual identity experiments: 28+ animated background studies across clouds, ocean, abyss and constellation families, built with canvas 2D, WebGL shaders, PixiJS and Babylon.js. Includes references like the pixijs.com header recreation.

sections.title: DevHunt Viewers
sections.summary: Client-side viewers over scraped DevHunt.org product listings dated 2026-02-28: 818 products in the full viewer and 206 with live previews. Search, filter and sort over embedded JSON.

sections.title: DUKR Platform

entries.title: Full-screen Text Carousel with Bullet Points
Full-screen Text Carousel with Bullet Points
Enhanced Text Carousel with Centered Text for Imageless Slides

sections.summary: The DUKR debate platform's corner: marketing pages ('every angle considered'), promo pricing, WebGL2 experiments, a Kevin Hart news tracker, and five self-contained GitHub-repo explorers (8,805 repos, 4,351 FOSS tools, 2,146 bookmarks). Includes the pricing page from the site root.

sections.title: CLF-C02 Exam Simulator
sections.summary: Focused AWS Cloud Practitioner exam simulator: 65 questions / 90 minutes, domain-weighted selection (26/25/33/16%), per-question timers, review tab with time statistics and export. Draws from a 5,252-question pool mirrored from the gen-1 datasets.

sections.title: Media Archive Showcases
sections.summary: Heavy single-file media archive showcases: 3,130 scraped coderprog.com posts and a 50,848-entry prizrak.ws catalog in a gzip+base64 embedded blob, browsed with virtualized tables and bookmark export. Dark terminal aesthetic at 13px.

sections.title: GJL Consulting

entries.title: GJL Consulting - Professional Business & Life Consulting
Terms and Conditions - GJL Consulting LLC

sections.summary: GJL Consulting LLC's real business website: five consulting services, testimonials, discovery-call booking and payment methods (PayPal/Venmo/Cash App/Zelle). Inter + Playfair Display, the only conventional multi-page site in the repo.

sections.title: Markdown Viewer
sections.summary: Markdown library of ten curated repository catalogs — RAG/memory systems, frontend UI kits, LLM training, browser automation and more — read through the site's Markdown Viewer (marked.js + DOMPurify + Prism).

sections.title: Markdown Viewer
sections.summary: Internal work documentation library: payroll/HR incident write-ups, eTES SQL patch plans and requirement docs. Read through the site's Markdown Viewer.

sections.title: Document Browser
sections.summary: Document browser for eleven pre-rendered AWS/AI-security study pages (CLF-C02 guides, well-architected pillars, exam notes) shown full-screen. The divergent sibling of the markdown readers.

sections.title: Investor Watchlists
sections.summary: Investor watchlist dashboards: a 132-ticker 2026 DRAM shortage thesis board and a 122-ticker IoT/sensors/physical-AI board, each with supply-chain and glossary tabs, sentiment filters and JSON export.

sections.title: Product Hunt Viewers
sections.summary: Self-contained Product Hunt viewers over embedded launch datasets: 11,872 products (Jun–Sep 2026), 8,449 (Jan–May) and a 1,337-item FOSS-only roundup. Month-colored chips, tag filters, favorites, virtualized card/table views and export. The repo's most polished design system.

sections.title: Markdown Viewer
sections.summary: ScamShield venture documentation: model system prompts, deployment guides (Railway/Render), go-live checklist, test plan, pitch prep and video storyboards — ~29 markdown docs read through the site's Markdown Viewer.

sections.title: Bluesky Reviews Browser
sections.summary: Browser over 13,983 Google Play reviews of the Bluesky app: full-text search, star filters, five sort orders, date ranges and developer responses. Frosted-glass cards on a purple gradient.
